title: melandrium dioicum subsp. album
intro: Melandrium dioicum subsp. album, commonly known as White-petaled Rock-campion, is a plant species belonging to the family Caryophyllaceae. It has been traditionally used in medicine to treat various health issues, including colds, coughs, and digestive problems, due to its potential health benefits. The therapeutic actions of White-petaled Rock-campion include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties.
